column1: # frametimeline.py classify: a late frame (shown more than a refresh after the time it asked for) is judged by the pair it makes with the picture shown before it: held = refreshes between the two presents, asked = refreshes between the two times asked for; repeated (held 2 or more), skipped (asked more than held by over 1 ms), shifted (the other jumps over 1 ms), on time (one picture a refresh as asked); seam (no picture before it, or a gap over 8 refreshes)
